unclear: Might not have arrived. Retry checks the chat first.
expired: Not sent: {name} was away for 24 hours
sending_now: This message is being sent right now. Try again in a moment.
not_kept: Earlier messages are still waiting to be sent, and this one couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment.
not_found: This message is no longer waiting to be sent.
read_only: This device can't change messages waiting to be sent.
store_failed: Couldn't change this message right now. Try again in a moment.
not_prepared: Persona couldn't get it ready to send
ahead: Earlier messages to this Agent are still waiting to be sent. Send this one after them.
check: Will check the chat when {name} is back
full: Too many messages are waiting for this Agent. Delete some, or send this one when the computer is back.
unconfirmed: Couldn't confirm it arrived. Retry to send it anyway, or delete it.
